text:
sam: Heads up — noticed a perf + quality anomaly after last night's kernel selector change for qwen-34b.
sam: Deploy shows p50 token latency jumped from ~55ms -> ~115ms on long-context workload (~2k seq).
sam: Also seeing eval-suite bleu/qa metrics drop on our customer prompt set: Quality delta ~ -0.8 (stat sig).
mia: ugh. which change exactly? kernel-selector config or quant toggle?
sam: kernel-selector preferred `tiled_attn_v2` for qwen family + we also turned `quantize-prefetch=true` in the same rollout. both rolled at ~02:15 UTC by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: deploy starting: kernel-selector-2024-11-03 -> prod (canary 100%) :rocket:
jorge: quick profiling: KV cache miss rate increased ~7% on canary. batching skewed — more small batches hitting slow path. stacktrace shows tiled kernel fallback to slow path for >8 heads cases.
mia: logs/snippet?
jorge: here's the selector snippet we pushed:
```
kernel_selector:
  - model_family: qwen
    prefer: tiled_attn_v2
    ropescale: auto
quant_toggles:
  qwen-34b: true
```
mia: ropescale:auto + tiled_attn seems suspicious for qwen. we saw RoPE scaling mismatches before with tiled kernels causing attention misalignment on upper heads.
alina: QA flagged generation hallucinations on the same prompt pack — sentences cut off mid-token more often.
nina (qa): failing test examples attached in the eval run: `qa-regression-171860` — majority of failures correlate with outputs that switch attention path mid-sequence.
sam: hypothesis: tiled_attn_v2 handles rope scaling differently -> KV offsets misapplied on head split -> occasional head-level rotation error -> results both slower (fallbacks) and lower quality.
mia: repro plan: run deterministic trace on qwen-34b with long prefix and `ROPESCALING=on` vs `off`, force tiled vs tiled-v1.
mia: also compare per-head attention norm distributions.
jorge: perf traces attached: p50 token latency heatmap shows spikes when tiled kernel enters slow fallback for layer 20-24. memory access pattern shows extra memcpys due to head packing.
sam: mitigation suggestion: rollback kernel-selector preference for qwen to `tiled_attn_v1` and disable `quantize-prefetch` toggle until we bisect.
alina: +1 on rollback. customer-facing risk is too high.
nina (qa): recommend canary rollback and re-run full eval suite on canary before wider rollout.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: kernel-selector-2024-11-03 -> canary-revert (10% traffic) :wrench:
sam: after rollback to v1 on 10% canary, p50 returned to ~58ms, kv miss delta back to baseline, eval metric recovered to within noise.
mia: next steps: bisect tiled_attn_v2 changes — pass through head packing, ropescale math, and quant prefetch interaction one at a time.
mia: owner? jon? (cc @jorge for profiling)
jorge: I'll take bisect. first check: ropescale handling in `attn_pack()` + unit test for head offsets.
sam: please also add a regression test in the eval harness that forces attention kernel swaps mid-sequence and checks output consistency.
alina: ping on timing — we should schedule a short post-mortem doc and list rollback criteria for future kernel rollouts.
sam: noted. I'll open a short issue and add rollback checklist.
mia: thanks all. good quick rollback. keep updates in this thread.
